title: Translation catalog
responsibility: Read registered translation dictionaries from one source revision without executing application code.

inputs.name: translationCatalog.tree
inputs.description: Snapshot of the selected revision's files, used only through list() and read(). Only files under a src/ directory with a JavaScript, TypeScript or .svelte extension are read as source, and a rejected list() or source read rejects the whole catalog.

inputs.name: translationCatalog.units
inputs.description: Registered units whose owns.source paths are matched against the same-scope files that call each $t or $_ key; each matching unit id is listed in that row's usedBy. Defaults to []: with no units, every usedBy is an empty list.

examples.title: Evidence grid
examples.responsibility: Show the evidence rows of one report revision.

inputs.name: flattenMessages.input
inputs.description: Dictionary object whose values are strings or nested dictionaries. A null, non-object or array input, or any nested value that is neither a string nor a non-null, non-array object, makes flattenMessages throw 'Dictionary must be an object.'

inputs.name: flattenMessages.prefix
inputs.description: Optional dotted path placed before every flattened key, so 'title' under prefix 'explorer.revision' becomes 'explorer.revision.title'. Defaults to an empty string, which adds no prefix.

inputs.name: translationMessages.text
inputs.description: TypeScript source text of one module, parsed but never evaluated. Only addMessages calls imported from svelte-i18n are inspected, and a locale or dictionary that is not static is recorded as a gap instead of an error.

outputs.name: catalog
outputs.description: Locales, dictionary rows and gaps read only from the selected revision; locales and rows are sorted, and gaps are de-duplicated. When two registrations give different text for the same locale and key, the first value read is kept and a gap is recorded.

gaps: src/i18n/setup.ts: Dictionary has a computed property or spread.

errors.name: SourceTree list() or read() error
errors.description: Rejects with the unchanged error from tree.list(), or from tree.read() on a matching source file; these reads are not caught, so one failure rejects the whole catalog. Failures reading JSON dictionaries are caught and recorded as gaps instead.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown by flattenMessages with 'Dictionary must be an object.' when its input is null, not an object or an array, or when a nested value is neither a string nor a non-null, non-array object. translationCatalog never rejects with it, because each source file's failures are caught and recorded as gaps.

outputs.name: flattenMessages
outputs.description: Flat map from dotted message keys, including any prefix, to string values. Empty strings and ICU expressions are kept verbatim, and the result is created without a prototype.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown with 'Dictionary must be an object.' when the input is null, not an object or an array, or when a nested value is neither a string nor a non-null, non-array object.

inputs.description: TypeScript source text of one module, parsed but never evaluated. Only addMessages calls imported from svelte-i18n are inspected, and a locale or dictionary that is not static is recorded as a gap instead of an error.

outputs.name: translationMessages
outputs.description: Static svelte-i18n registrations for each addMessages call (a literal messages map, or the specifier of the JSON module it imports), the unique literal $t or $_ keys, and gaps for calls that cannot be read statically.

gaps: Dynamic locale or dictionary cannot be inspected statically.
